title: Lab Technician (Pathology)
must_have: At least 2 years of work in a pathology or diagnostic lab
Hands-on with automated haematology or biochemistry analysers
screening_questions: Which analysers have you run yourself, and what daily QC did you do on them?
What would you do if a critical potassium value came out on a sample?
What is your notice period and expected monthly or yearly salary?

interview.mode: in person at the Rohini lab
